title: Rescission or Cancellation at the Notice Date: Named Non-Owner Policy
content:
Once a notice of cancellation for nonpayment is pending on a Named Non-Owner Policy term, one of two outcomes follows.

**Rescission.** A pending cancellation is rescinded only when payments posted to the term's billing plan on or before the cancellation effective date total at least the minimum due stated on the notice. A partial payment does not rescind. The test reads the posting dates and amounts on the plan and the minimum due recorded from the notice.

**Cancellation.** The cancellation for nonpayment is processed no earlier than the cancellation effective date stated on the notice. The comparison is made on calendar dates: the processing date must be on or after the cancellation effective date itself, with a processing lag of 0 days added. On that date, with the minimum due unpaid, coverage ends at 12:01 a.m., the closing date is the cancellation effective date, unearned premium is returned pro rata and fees are not returned.

| Payments posted on or before the effective date | Outcome |
|---|---|
| total at least the minimum due on the notice | rescinded |
| total less than the minimum due (a partial payment) | not rescinded; the cancellation is processed on or after the effective date |

*Hypothetical:* minimum due 63.10 on a notice effective 18 June. Payments of 40.00 on 10 June and 23.10 on 18 June total 63.10 on or before the effective date, so the cancellation is rescinded. A single payment of 63.10 posted on 19 June comes after the effective date and does not count toward rescission. Processing the cancellation on 17 June would be before the effective date; on 18 June it may be processed.
